title: Study on material basis and network mechanism of the Guizhi Fuling pills in the treatment of endometriosis and endometrial polyps.
authors: Cui, Lianghui; Yang, Jia; Zhang, Yuli; Wang, Yu; Xie, Wei; Xue, Xiaoou
one_liner_zh: 该文基于网络药理学和机器学习研究桂枝茯苓丸治疗子宫内膜异位症和息肉的物质基础与网络机制，核心为药物靶点与疾病通路分析，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: To explore the material basis and network mechanism of the Guizhi Fuling pills in the treatment of endometriosis and endometrial polyps based on network pharmacology and machine learning. The effective constituents and targets of the Guizhi Fuling pills were obtained based on the TCMSP and SymMAP databases. Endometrial polyps disease genes were retrieved by GenCards and OMIM databases. The active component-common disease target was obtained using Venn Diagram, which was uploaded to the STRING database and Cytoscape software to construct the protein interaction network and analyze its molecular biological mechanism. Random walk with restart was run on the compound network and protein-protein interaction network to detect core compounds, targets, and the stability of the relapse network. Then, the biological function and pathway enrichment analysis of the core targets were carried out with the help of the DAVID database, and the key targets of the pathway were further obtained. Finally, molecular docking verification was conducted. A total of 30 disease targets were obtained. According to gene ontology analysis, the treatment of endometriosis and endometrial polyps with Guizhi Fuling pills mainly focused on biological processes such as rhythm process, mechanical stimulation response, DNA binding regulation, and other biological processes. The signaling pathways are mainly concentrated in apoptosis, TNF signaling pathway, IL-17 signaling pathway, toll-like receptor signaling pathway, VEGF signaling pathway, estrogen signaling pathway, nuclear factor-kappa B signaling pathway, hepatitis signaling pathway, etc. Then, the 10 effective components and 10 target proteins were further verified by molecular docking. The results showed that beta-sitosterol, luteolin, and quercetin were the most closely connected with the target NR3C1 and MMP9, respectively, which may be the key compounds and core target proteins in the "different diseases and the same treatment" of the Guizhi Fuling pills. The mechanisms of its comorbidity mainly involved estrogen, tumor, inflammation, immune response, and other signaling pathways, and were closely related to several biological processes. It can provide research direction for further research on the mechanism of "treating different diseases with the same treatment" of the Guizhi Fuling pills.
abstract_zh: 基于网络药理学和机器学习探讨桂枝茯苓丸治疗子宫内膜异位症和子宫内膜息肉的物质基础及网络机制。基于TCMSP和SymMAP数据库获取桂枝茯苓丸的有效成分及靶点。通过GenCards和OMIM数据库检索子宫内膜息肉疾病基因。利用Venn Diagram获取活性成分-共同疾病靶点，上传至STRING数据库和Cytoscape软件构建蛋白质相互作用网络并分析其分子生物学机制。在化合物网络和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络上运行带重启的随机游走，以检测核心化合物、靶点及复发网络的稳定性。随后，借助DAVID数据库对核心靶点进行生物学功能和通路富集分析，并进一步获取通路关键靶点。最后进行分子对接验证。共获得30个疾病靶点。根据基因本体论分析，桂枝茯苓丸治疗子宫内膜异位症和子宫内膜息肉主要涉及节律过程、机械刺激反应、DNA结合调控等生物学过程。信号通路主要集中在凋亡、TNF信号通路、IL-17信号通路、toll样受体信号通路、VEGF信号通路、雌激素信号通路、核因子-κB信号通路、肝炎信号通路等。随后，通过分子对接进一步验证了10个有效成分和10个靶蛋白。结果表明，β-谷甾醇、木犀草素和槲皮素分别与靶点NR3C1和MMP9连接最为紧密，可能是桂枝茯苓丸“异病同治”的关键化合物和核心靶蛋白。其共病机制主要涉及雌激素、肿瘤、炎症、免疫反应等信号通路，并与多个生物学过程密切相关。可为深入研究桂枝茯苓丸“异病同治”机制提供研究方向。
